The app must show a quick-reply button on its notification (like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Messages). Apps without inline reply are skipped automatically.
Only if your phone uses a different app ID for the second WhatsApp. Find it in Settings → Apps → your clone app → App details.
Comma-separated, e.g. com.whatsapp (only if your OEM reports a different ID). Many dual apps still use com.whatsapp — then you only need the main WhatsApp toggle above.
Important facts & rules for the selected app (activities, prices, timings, policies). Saved separately per app and synced to Firebase.

The app writes the caption, creates an image, and can publish for you. Fill the sections below in order — only your Facebook Page step is required before anything goes live. Tap Save when you’re done.
Topics & tone → Image style → Schedule → Link Page → Save
Business name, tone, rules for text, rotating topics, and caption language.
Optional but recommended. Describe colors and vibe so pictures match your brand. The AI does not download images from links — describe your logo in words if you want it hinted in art.
Turn on auto-post and pick one time per day (your phone’s local time).
Use Connect Page for the easiest setup. Paste ID and token only if you prefer to enter them yourself.
Manual setup (skip if you used Connect)
Paste the numeric Page ID and a Page access token from Meta’s tools. Your token stays encrypted on this device.
Stored on this device. When you’re signed in, schedule and topics sync to your account.
Rules for every caption (promos, audience, phrases to include or avoid)
Each numbered row is one future post. Use “Add topic” for more rows, or remove a row you don’t need (one row must stay).
Pick the language for post text. Choose Custom to type a specific language below.
Custom language name or dialect (when you chose Custom)
Logo link — for your notes only (optional)
Describe your logo for the AI (colors, shapes, style)
Tap a circle to fill the box you last tapped (defaults to main color). Or type # plus 6 hex digits.
Overall style (e.g. clean & minimal, bold & colorful)
Picture-only rules (background, people, products, things to avoid)
Pick a style below, then adjust the text if you want more detail.
Warm and conversational, like talking to a friend. Light emoji only if it fits naturally.
Clear, trustworthy, and business-appropriate. Avoid slang; stay concise.
Fun, witty, and energetic. Safe humor; still readable.
Short and action-focused for offers or deadlines—excited but not spammy.
Very short lines. No fluff; one idea per sentence.
Uplifting and motivational; positive without sounding generic.
Topic / focus (legacy — use rotating topics above)
Token type must be Page (not User). In Graph API Explorer, select your Page, then generate a token — or use Connect Page above to skip this.

First you\'ll sign in with your Facebook profile (that\'s normal). Then this screen lists Pages you manage — tap Use on the Page you want for auto-posting. If that Page is linked to an Instagram Business account, Instagram details are saved automatically too. Tokens stay encrypted on this device only.

Unpublished app: you can test without Google Play. Add your Facebook account under App roles (Admin / Developer / Tester). On OPPO/Oplus phones, login uses an in-app browser instead of the Facebook app so OAuth can return to this app.
Facebook is not configured. Add FACEBOOK_APP_ID (and FACEBOOK_CLIENT_TOKEN from Meta Developer App → Settings → Advanced) to local.properties and rebuild.
Facebook web login failed. Retrying in app…
No Pages found. Create a Facebook Page or ensure your account is an admin of that Page, then try again.
Login succeeded but Page access wasn\'t granted. In Meta Developer App enable Facebook Login and test as an admin; ensure the login flow includes Pages access.
Not connected — use Connect Page or enter credentials below.
Instagram Business Account ID (optional if Connect found it)
Sign in with Facebook, then choose a Page that is linked to your Instagram Business account. We will save your Instagram account details for auto-posting.
No Instagram Business account found on your Pages. Link Instagram to your Facebook Page in Meta Business settings, then try again.
Facebook Page disconnected on this device
Link your Page with Facebook Login, then open posting options. Schedule settings sync to Firebase when you are signed in (tokens stay on this device).

Checklist:

1) Access Token Debugger must show Type: Page (not User). In Graph API Explorer, pick your Page in the user/page dropdown, then Generate — paste that token.

2) If the error says the app cannot post or is in development: In developers.facebook.com → your app → Roles → add your Facebook profile as Admin/Developer/Tester (same account that owns the Page). Or publish the app and complete App Review for pages_manage_posts for wider use.

3) Page ID must match the Page for that token (see me/accounts).

4) SSL/connection messages during upload are often temporary; if the dialog shows a Facebook OAuth error, the failure is at the Facebook step, not Storage.
